name: Crystal Ball Sequence
description: Crystal ball sequence on hexagonal lattice is defined as follows: n -th element is the number of lattice points inside a hexagon with ( n + 1) points on each side. The formula is H n = 3· n ·( n + 1) + 1 . You are given n ; calculate n -th element of the sequence.
input_specification: The only line of input contains an integer n ( 0 ≤ n ≤ 9 ).
output_specification: Output the n -th element of crystal ball sequence.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
